'''Florg Nerfherder''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He trained in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and fought a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi]] in the Temple dueling ring. He wielded a blue-green [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
Florg Nerfherder is a stand-in character in the multiplayer duels if no other player is selected. However, he is most likely a canon character, as he is seen training behind [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] elsewhere in the Temple, with the same lightsaber and robes.
